prediction: The fix will introduce a new conditional check in the AnswersValidator class that verifies if the invocation's method belongs to an interface when 'CallsRealMethods' is used, and throws an exception if it does.

reasoning_summary: The bug is a classic missing validation check. The system allowed an invalid operation (calling a real method on an interface) because it lacked a guard clause to verify the type of the declaring class. The fix adds this missing check, which is the definition of the 'Checking' ODC type.
